---
name: documentation-release-engineering
description: Maintain accurate setup guides, API documentation, deployment instructions, changelogs, and release checklists.
---
# Documentation and release
- Verify instructions against source code and package scripts.
- Document prerequisites, setup, env variables, run/test/build, deployment, rollback, and troubleshooting.
- Never include real secrets, tokens, or personal data.
- Document REST and Socket.IO contracts, auth requirements, payloads, and errors.
- Add migration notes for schema, API, event, and configuration changes.
- Release checklist: clean install, tests, build, env validation, health checks, logs, privacy/security review, rollback.
